title: No web mutation waits on a row a reconcile pass holds
assertion: The web’s request pools set `lock_timeout` (three seconds) on every connection, and the web’s own code opens a database connection no other way (the model gateway’s pool excepted, by name); while a second session holds a case’s row as a reconcile pass does, assigning the case on such a pool answers `busy` with the closed word `records` after about the timeout and never after the holder, and writes no row, audit event or request key; with the row free the same assignment under the same request key goes through
noFileReason: The reconciliation routes’ SYNTHETIC LED-06 practice on a pool opened as the web opens its own, with a second session holding a case’s row: no file.
